entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...A certain young man is faced with[n]a dilemma due to the unjust oppression[n]by the government!
entries.uk: ...Один юнак опинився в скруті через[n]несправедливий утиск з боку влади!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: He is suffering from a crime he did not[n]commit!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: He is a promising young man who will[n]support this country's future!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: What justice is there in a country without[n]it being able to save such an individual!?
